title: Change log
subtitle: New features and changes to how you work in Multica.

v0_3_53.title: Order set progress and creator
v0_3_53.summary: Orders show complete selected sets and the person who created them.
changes: Order lists and details show set progress, such as 3/3 sets generated. Candidate and reserve images do not count toward the order target.
Order lists and details show the creator.
Clarified that first-package duration remains fixed after completion; later edits, repairs, and rework are excluded.

v0_3_52.title: Workflows and user credential fixes
v0_3_52.summary: View squad workflows and use correctly matched user integration credentials.
changes: The Squads navigation tab is now named Workflows.
Squad details include a workflow view to inspect collaboration stages and handoffs, and adjust stages and agent assignments.
Fixed user integration credential matching so agents can use custom credentials saved by the user who initiated the task when calling integrated services.

v0_3_51.title: Prime modes and creative details
v0_3_51.summary: Compare draft and published market settings with the processing used for a creative.
changes: Use Save and publish in market rules and view draft and published Prime modes side by side.
Orders show their Prime mode at submission; creative details show the recorded processing mode and template used.

v0_3_50.title: Choose creative set counts
v0_3_50.summary: Choose how many creative sets to produce, with three sizes in each set.
changes: Copy-library orders support 1-10 sets, with three as the default. Ten sets deliver 30 images.
See the expected image count before submitting and the completed set count during production.

v0_3_49.title: Copy-based creatives, gallery, and Astra
v0_3_49.summary: Create from your copy library, manage finished images, and select GPT-6 Astra for agents.
changes: Create image orders from approved copy and repayment plans. All selections are optional; leave them empty for visual-only exploration.
Preview gallery images at full size, switch sizes, and undo removals. Gallery membership stays linked to the order.
Codex agents can use GPT-6 Astra with the thinking levels supported by their runtime.

v0_3_48.title: Switch adjusted creative versions
v0_3_48.summary: Choose between the finished images before and after an adjustment.
changes: Use the new creative after a precise adjustment, or switch back to the complete previous version without producing it again.

v0_3_47.title: Creative candidates and three-size sets
v0_3_47.summary: Compare creative directions before producing square, landscape, and portrait images.
changes: Competitor-material orders begin with four or five primary images. Independent review selects three sets for delivery and retains reserves.
Keep the subject and visual style consistent across each set, with a composition suited to each image size.

v0_3_23.title: Creative Factory and agent settings
v0_3_23.summary: Enable Creative Factory per workspace to manage collection through image delivery.
changes: Creative Factory connects material collection, analysis, copy confirmation, image generation, and delivery.
Choose GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, or Luna for Codex agents and set the thinking level supported by each model.
Filter requirements by multiple labels, matching any selected label. Creative workflow child issues appear in production-stage order.
